evidence_items.explanation: This is material counterevidence to a broad inference that most customers receive no returns. The vendor-commissioned survey covers 3,466 leaders at organizations with deployed generative AI and measures returns on use cases, without establishing whether overall returns met expectations.

unresolved_gaps: No reviewed study establishes the proportion of the broader business-customer population whose realized generative AI returns fell short of its own expectations.
The studies use different populations and measures: pilots, significant ROI, broad AI value, and returns from at least one use case.
Customers still expecting future returns cannot automatically be counted as disappointed customers.
The McKinsey survey could not be verified through read_page.
